home.express.body: Build emoji and sticker packs, share one with a link, and install anyone else's. They work in every server and every message, animated ones included, with no tier to buy and no limit on how many you keep.
home.express.title: Your emoji, everywhere
home.foot.tagline: Nexa. End to end encrypted chat, voice and servers.
home.hero.fine: No email address. A username and a password, and you are in.
home.hero.lede: Messages, files and calls are encrypted on your device with keys the server never holds. Everything else is the chat app you already know, with the parts it is missing filled in.
home.hero.title: Chat that nobody else can read.
home.point.encryptedBody: Every message, file and call is encrypted on your device. The server keeps ciphertext it cannot read, and private channels carry keys of their own that change the moment someone loses access.
home.point.exportBody: Export your profile, friends, servers and every message you hold a key for, decrypted on your device into a zip. Nothing is decrypted on the server to do it.
home.point.guestsBody: A guest link gets someone into a call in seconds, encrypted like everyone else, with no access to anything but the call.
home.point.languagesBody: The whole app, properly translated, with the plural rules each language actually uses. Arabic reads right to left, and the layout goes with it.
home.point.lockBody: A passcode that never leaves the device, on a timer or the moment you look away. Your keys go with it.
home.point.noEmailBody: Signing up asks for a username and a password. No address to confirm, no phone number, nothing to leak later.
home.point.packsBody: Make a pack, share it with a link, and anyone can install it and use it anywhere. They are not stuck inside the server they came from.
home.point.presenceBody: The desktop app picks up Rich Presence from your games and music and passes it to Discord as well, so you do not have to choose which one to run.
home.point.previewsBody: The server fetches the page and hands you the preview, so the site you linked never sees your address. GIF search works the same way.
home.point.previewsTitle: Link previews that do not out you
home.point.searchBody: Searching runs on your device over the messages it has decrypted, with from:, in:, has: and dates. The server could not help even if it wanted to.
home.point.subchatsBody: Start a side conversation inside any channel or DM. It has its own encryption key, and you can put a password on it so only the people you tell can open it.
home.point.zoomBody: Pinch or scroll to zoom a shared screen, a camera, a picture or a GIF, and drag it around while you are in there.

legal.new1: Moderation: staff can remove profile pictures, reset profile text, mute, ban, or delete accounts. Every action comes with a reason, a notice from Nexa, and a private thread to appeal in.
legal.new2: Nexa, the official account, sends those notices and announcements. Case threads with Nexa are not end-to-end encrypted: staff can read them.
legal.new3: Deleting an account removes everything it posted and uploaded, whoever deletes it. Deleting your own also deletes your direct message conversations, for both people in them.
legal.new4: New rules against impersonation and against getting around a mute or ban, a minimum age of 13, and a section on how long things are kept.
legal.hlPrivateBody: Messages, files, and calls are encrypted on your device. Nobody who runs Nexa can read them.
legal.hlStaffBody: Public profiles and images, the delivery details the server needs, and moderation cases. Case threads with Nexa are not end-to-end encrypted.
legal.hlModerationBody: Every action comes with a reason, a notice from Nexa naming who acted, and a private thread to appeal in. All of it is logged.
legal.hlRulesBody: Keep it legal, respect copyright, no gore, no hate or harassment, no impersonation, and no abuse of the service.
legal.hlDataBody: No email, no phone number, nothing sold, nothing tracked. The Privacy Policy lists every field that is kept.
